baseline_summary: Baseline = tick-based differential-drive odometry with closed-form covariance. Encoder ticks (N=4096/rev, delta = 2*pi*r/N = 1.15e-4 m at r=0.075 m) -> wheel arcs delta_s_L/R -> midpoint integration of p=[x,y,theta] (per-step error O(delta_s*delta_theta^2), verified against exact ICR arc). Per-wheel noise sigma_i^2 = k_i|delta_s_i| + delta^2/6 (Chong-Kleeman slip/floor term + quantisation). Pose covariance propagated with closed-form Jacobians F_p (3x3) and F_u (3x2) [Sigma_{k+1} = F_p Sigma F_p^T + F_u Sigma_u F_u^T, O(1)/step]. Twist covariance for robot_localization: Var(vx) = (sigma_R^2+sigma_L^2)/(4 dt^2), Var(omega) = (sigma_R^2+sigma_L^2)/(b^2 dt^2) + omega^2 sigma_b^2/b^2, Cov(vx,omega) = (sigma_R^2-sigma_L^2)/(2 b dt^2), Var(vy) = sigma_vy0^2 + (kappa_y vx omega)^2; placed at covariance indices 0, 35, 5/30, 7; unused diagonals 1e-3 (robot_localization substitutes 1e-6 for zeros; docs warn against inflating to ignore). Quantisation makes 100 Hz single-difference encoder yaw-rate noise ~0.019 rad/s, 2-10x noisier than the gyro, which the formulas expose. Drift closed forms: straight L -> Var(theta)=2kL/b^2, Var(y)=2kL^3/(3b^2); rotation Theta -> Var(theta)=k|Theta|/b; systematic radius-ratio/baseline errors dominate (0.5% ratio error -> 2.9 m lateral after 20 m). Stack facts verified in the amr-fleet-system container / upstream source: Gazebo Fortress DiffDrive computes odometry from noise-free joint positions, publishes no covariance and its own TF; WheelSlip plugin applies slip = compliance*(r|w|)/F_N; gz IMU orientation is ground truth (only rates/accels get white + constant + Gauss-Markov bias noise), so IMU yaw must not be fused (orientation_covariance[0] = -1); ros_gz_bridge supports JointState<->gz.msgs.Model so a self-built tick emulator on /joint_states is the encoder path. Sensor preprocessing baselines: LiDAR range/angle/footprint/shadow(beta = atan2(r_{i+1} sin da, r_i - r_{i+1} cos da))/speckle filters equivalent to installed laser_filters 2.0.9 plugins; depth decimation + pinhole back-projection (f_x = 337 px) + height crop + 0.05 m closest-point voxel grid (PCL 1.12 headers + pcl_conversions; pcl_ros/depth_image_proc not installed); IMU first-order IIR LPF (alpha = dt/(tau+dt)) + startup/ZUPT Gauss-Markov bias Kalman filter matched to the gz-sensors noise model + Allan variance identification.

proposals.name: SACO — Slip-Adaptive Covariance Odometry (chi-square gated 2-channel slip detector + covariance inflation + gyro-substituted heading)
proposals.idea: Every T_w = 0.05-0.1 s compute r_omega = omega_enc - (omega_gyro - b_g) and r_a = a_enc - (a_x_imu - b_a), normalise by the quantisation-aware encoder variances plus LPF'd IMU variances (S_omega, S_a) and test d^2 = r_omega^2/S_omega + r_a^2/S_a ~ chi2(2) with hysteresis (on 9.21, off 4.6 for 0.2 s). When flagged: Var(omega) += r_omega^2, Var(vx) += (r_a T_w)^2 + (b r_omega/2)^2, held with exponential decay (tau_d = 0.3 s), and the odom-frame heading increment is replaced by the gyro rate; the resulting twist covariance is what robot_localization consumes. The accelerometer channel catches symmetric longitudinal slip that the gyro cannot see.
proposals.closest_prior_work: Borenstein & Feng 1996 Gyrodometry (gyro/encoder discrepancy switch); Ward & Iagnemma 2008 T-RO (dynamic-model IMU-based slip detector); Oeltjen et al. 2025 (commanded-vs-measured slip detection); Yu et al. IROS 2023 (slip-velocity RI-EKF + DOB); Okawara et al. 2024 (online wheel-odometry covariance in factor graph).
proposals.expected_gain: In low-friction-patch and payload-change scenarios: >50% reduction of odometry heading error during slip (gyro substitution), EKF NEES inside the 95% chi-square band (fixed-covariance baseline typically over-confident), smaller AMCL correction jumps, helping the 8 cm rotation / 5 cm straight targets; false-alarm rate <= 1% on no-slip data.
proposals.risks: Gyro/accelerometer bias mis-estimation biases residuals (mitigated by ZUPT bias KF and Allan-based noise settings); if Gazebo IMU noise is set unrealistically small the test is trivial, and without WheelSlip patches in the world there is nothing to detect; differentiated encoder velocity is noisy (T_w = 0.1 s gives sigma_a ~ 7e-3 m/s^2, still far below 0.3 m/s^2 slip residuals); over-inflation could starve the EKF of velocity information (bounded by decay and gamma_max).
proposals.realtime_budget: ~200 flops per 100 Hz step, < 5 us; < 0.1% of one core per robot, negligible for 5 robots on the 32-thread CPU.

proposals.name: GRC — Gyro-Referenced Recursive Least-Squares wheel-parameter calibration with covariance feedback
proposals.idea: Parameterise psi = [r_R/b, r_L/b] so the gyro model omega_gyro - b_g = phi_dot_R psi_R - phi_dot_L psi_L is linear; run a forgetting-factor RLS (lambda 0.995-0.9995) only in no-slip, excited (|phi_dot| > 1 rad/s), non-ZUPT windows. Straight motion observes psi_R - psi_L (radius ratio), in-place rotation observes psi_R + psi_L = 2 r_bar/b, so normal warehouse driving provides persistent excitation; cond(P) freezes unexcited directions. Recover b = 2 r_bar/(psi_R+psi_L), r_i = psi_i b; the absolute scale r_bar is unobservable from the gyro and is either held nominal or slowly corrected from AMCL displacement ratios on long straight segments. The RLS covariance Sigma_psi = sigma_e^2 P is injected into Var(omega) and Var(vx) as h^T Sigma_psi h terms, so the EKF covariance justification is data-driven.
proposals.closest_prior_work: De Giorgi, De Palma, Parlangeli 2023 (Robotics 13(1):7) online odometry calibration with slippage using encoders+gyro+IMU; Antonelli et al. 2005 T-RO linear least-squares odometry calibration; Censi et al. 2013 T-RO; Okawara et al. 2024/2025 online kinematic calibration in factor graphs.
proposals.expected_gain: With a deliberately perturbed nominal model (5% radius-ratio/baseline error, emulating tyre wear/payload) GRC should converge to within 1% in about 60 s of mixed driving, removing systematic drift that otherwise reaches 0.29 rad heading and ~2.9 m lateral error over 20 m; UMBmark E_max,syst reduced by an order of magnitude versus uncalibrated odometry.
proposals.risks: Scale (mean radius) is not observable from the gyro alone; gyro bias errors map directly into psi (needs good ZUPT bias tracking); insufficient rotational excitation on long straight corridors makes psi_R + psi_L drift with forgetting (mitigated by cond(P) freeze / directional forgetting as in Gu et al. 2026); in a rigid-body simulator radius changes must be emulated by parameter mismatch rather than physical tyre compression.
proposals.realtime_budget: 2x2 RLS update per 100 Hz step (< 50 flops), plus diagnostics publishing; negligible.

evaluation_plan: Experiments (Gazebo ground truth via pose/OdometryPublisher bridge, logs in the spec's [timestamp, gt_x, gt_y, est_x, est_y, error] format with >= 100 samples): T1 straight 20 m x10 both directions at 1.0/2.0 m/s (final error, error/L %, heading drift deg/m, fit of k from Var(theta) vs L); T2 in-place rotation +/-10 rev x5 at 1.5 rad/s (heading error, k|Theta|/b fit, baseline error); T3 UMBmark 4 m square CW x5 / CCW x5 (E_max,syst = max(r_cg,cw, r_cg,ccw), CW/CCW centroids -> E_b/E_d, plus direct nonlinear LS identification of (r_L, r_R, b) from 100 Hz ground truth); T4 slip: three 2x2 m low-friction patches (WheelSlip compliance) and payload 0/10/25 kg (detection rate and false-alarm rate against GT slip |v_gt - v_enc|/v_gt > 5%, heading error, EKF RMSE/max error, AMCL jump magnitude); T5 consistency: NEES (p-p_hat)^T Sigma^-1 (p-p_hat) ~ chi2(3) fraction inside 95% band and EKF NIS on all runs; T6 static 60 s x5 (position RMSE, IMU bias estimate vs long-run mean, Allan deviation curve); T7 preprocessing: synthetic and simulated scans (removal rates, equivalence with laser_filters chain, costmap false-obstacle count, depth points/frame and latency); T8 resource: per-node CPU and topic rates with 5 robots. Comparison arms: (A) Gazebo DiffDrive built-in odometry (no quantisation, no covariance), (B) our baseline with fixed-k covariance, (C) +SACO, (D) +SACO+GRC. Mapped spec targets: localisation error static 3 cm / straight 5 cm / rotation 8 cm (through EKF+AMCL with our covariances), drift report, covariance justification, CPU <= 80%.
implementation_plan: Package amr_kinematics (C++17, ament_cmake, Eigen3, per-robot namespaces, YAML params). Header-only pure functions in include/amr_kinematics/: diff_drive_kinematics.hpp (fk, integrate_midpoint, integrate_arc, jacobians F_p/F_u/F_rho, twist_covariance), encoder_emulator.hpp (joint angle -> int64 ticks, unwrap, quantise, optional multiplicative slip noise), slip_detector.hpp (SACO), gyro_rls_calibrator.hpp (GRC), iir_filter.hpp, bias_kf.hpp. Nodes: src/wheel_odometry_node.cpp (sub /joint_states from ros_gz_bridge gz.msgs.Model and /imu/data; pub /wheel_odom nav_msgs/Odometry child_frame_id=base_link, publish_tf=false, pose+twist covariance per the formulas; /wheel_odom/diagnostics with d^2, slip flag, psi_hat, P), src/imu_preprocess_node.cpp (/imu/raw -> /imu/data: LPF, bias KF, orientation_covariance[0] = -1), src/laser_preprocess_node.cpp (/scan -> /scan_filtered: REP-117 range, angular mask, footprint, shadow, speckle), src/depth_cloud_node.cpp (depth image + CameraInfo -> decimate, back-project, height crop, 0.05 m closest-point voxel -> /camera/points_ds PointCloud2 using PCL 1.12 headers + pcl_conversions). Tools: tools/drift_experiment.py, umbmark.py, allan.py (rosbag2 -> metrics/plots). ROS/Nav2 interfaces: robot_localization ekf (two_d_mode true, 50 Hz) odom0=/wheel_odom (vx, vy, vyaw), imu0=/imu/data (vyaw, ax, ay; yaw=false), pose0=/amcl_pose; costmap observation_sources scan_filtered (LaserScan) and points_ds (PointCloud2). Gazebo: DiffDrive used only as cmd_vel controller (its odom/TF not bridged), JointStatePublisher, WheelSlip, IMU/LiDAR/depth noise per SDF (gyro stddev 0.005, bias 0.005, dynamic_bias_stddev 8e-5 with tau 300 s; accel 0.05; lidar 0.03 m), low-friction patch world. Unit tests (gtest, coverage >= 70%): FK invariants, midpoint vs arc error bound, Jacobians vs finite differences (1e-6), covariance propagation vs 1e4-sample Monte Carlo (5%), quantisation sigma, RLS convergence (2%) and slip freeze, chi-square detector FA <= 1% / detection >= 95%, shadow/speckle/REP-117 behaviour, voxel invariants, LPF -3 dB, bias-KF convergence; launch_pytest integration. Compute budget: odometry 100 Hz < 5 us/step, IMU 100 Hz, LiDAR 10 Hz x 720 beams (~10 us), depth 15 Hz x 19.2k points (< 1 ms) -> < 3% of one core per robot, < 15% total for 5 robots. Schedule: week 1 kinematics/emulator/covariance/tests, week 2 three preprocessing nodes, week 3 SACO+GRC, week 4 experiments and report.
open_questions: Wheel radius, wheel separation and encoder gear ratio are not fixed in the spec; the brief assumes r = 0.075 m, b = 0.35 m, 4096 ticks at the wheel axle — must be agreed with the URDF/simulation team.

How the EKF/localisation team wants to handle the absolute odometry scale (mean wheel radius), which is unobservable from the gyro: nominal value only, or the optional AMCL-displacement scale correction interface.

The spec's example ekf config fuses IMU yaw; since the Gazebo IMU orientation is ground truth, the team must decide to publish orientation_covariance[0] = -1 (recommended) or to integrate a noisy yaw in our IMU node.
Which floor-friction and WheelSlip compliance values (and low-friction patch layout) the world team will implement — the slip experiments and SACO validation depend on them.
Whether payload-dependent effective wheel radius should be emulated in the encoder emulator (rigid-body Gazebo wheels do not compress), and with what magnitude.

arXiv API was rate-limited (HTTP 429) for most of the session, so the 2023-2026 survey relied on four API listings plus individual abstract pages; a rerun of the remaining targeted queries (laser-scan filtering, gyro-bias/ZUPT for wheeled robots) is recommended before the final report.
